At Spirii, we are building world-class charging products and digital solutions for the future of mobility. Our Digital Development team drives a listen, learn, and lead culture that keeps us improving how we work and how we build.

We are now looking for a Cloud Engineer to join us on this journey. In this role, you will help our engineering teams embrace the DevOps mindset while designing and running our cloud setup. You will be part of building and maintaining a modern, scalable, and secure cloud platform that powers Spirii’s products.

You will report to our Engineering Manager and work closely with colleagues across our Engineering teams, both in-house and near-shore.

**What You Will Be Working On

**

• Build, operate, and improve Spirii’s AWS and Kubernetes (EKS) infrastructure to ensure reliability, scalability, and performance.

• Automate infrastructure provisioning with CDK for Terraform (CDKTF).

• Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling for fast, secure delivery.

• Collaborate with engineering teams to embed platform capabilities and DevOps best practices.

• Ensure security best practices and protect against threats across our cloud setup.

• Monitor infrastructure health and performance using tools like Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, and CloudWatch.

• Troubleshoot and resolve issues across infrastructure, CI/CD, and runtime environments.

• Document processes for knowledge sharing and smooth onboarding.

• Contribute to incident management and disaster recovery processes.

**Who You Are

**

• You enjoy working hands-on with cloud infrastructure while enabling others to succeed.

• You bring a DevOps mindset and like to share your knowledge to drive adoption.

• You have a strong sense of ownership and pride in building quality solutions.

• You communicate clearly and collaborate easily across teams.

• You care about developer experience and making platforms easy to use.

• You contribute to an open, friendly, and collaborative team culture.

**What You Bring

****Must-have

**

• A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.

• 4+ years in a Cloud/DevOps/Platform Engineer role.

• Strong experience with AWS (EKS, RDS, S3, CloudFront, IAM, etc.) and security best practices.

• Kubernetes (EKS) administration and operations.

• Infrastructure as code with Terraform or CDKTF.

• CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance (GitHub Actions or similar).

• Linux/Unix systems and scripting with TypeScript.

• Monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch).

• Excellent troubleshooting skills.

**Nice-to-have

**

• Experience with platform development (shared services, APIs).

• Working with SQL and NoSQL databases.

• Knowledge of security architecture for cloud-native applications.

**Benefits

**It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours, and a good work-life balance.

• Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.

• Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

• Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but Fluent English language skills are required.

**About Spirii – Who We Are

**Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii has recently celebrated its six-year anniversary as a founded company, however the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as development of future transport- and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

Gasoline Grill is looking for a hands-on and curious IT & Data Coordinator to be the go-to person for all things digital and technical across our business.

The role combines reporting and data, platform ownership, IT support, and user administration. You will be based primarily at our office, but you will head out to our restaurants whenever something needs a hands-on fix. One day you might be untangling a Power Automate flow, the next you are troubleshooting a kiosk screen or setting up a new employee's email and Teams access.

About Gasoline Grill

Gasoline Grill was founded in 2016 and today has seven company-owned locations, three franchise restaurants, and around 150 employees from more than 30 nationalities.

You will become part of a small office team of 12 people who work closely together and take great pride in helping each other.

About The Role

You will maintain and develop our Power BI reports and dashboards, and build automated workflows in Power Automate that pull data from our operational systems, such as POS, scheduling, and stock, into our daily reports. When colleagues need data, you will pull and prepare it in a format that works for them, including extracting data programmatically from systems without easy exports.

You will own our internal business platform and act as first-line support for our core operational software, resolving issues as they come up and escalating to vendors when needed. On select platforms, you will be the main point of contact for external partners, coordinating new features, troubleshooting, and general upkeep.

You will oversee IT equipment across all locations, from POS hardware to kiosks and networking gear, keep track of what exists where, and flag or replace anything that is failing or outdated. You will also manage user accounts in Microsoft 365, keeping access and permissions organized as people join, change roles, or leave.

Finally, you will keep an eye out for where AI can genuinely improve how we work, and help test and implement the ideas that make sense.

Key Responsibilities

• Power BI reporting, dashboards, and data preparation for teams

• Automated workflows in Power Automate across operational systems

• Ownership of our internal business platform and first-line software support

• IT equipment and on-site support across all restaurant locations

• User accounts, email, Teams, and access management in Microsoft 365

• Identifying, testing, and implementing practical AI solutions

WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

• Has experience with, or can quickly learn, BI and automation tools such as Power BI and Power Automate

• Has intermediate scripting skills, for example Python, for data extraction

• Troubleshoots independently and digs in rather than waiting for a manual

• Is familiar with Microsoft 365 administration or learns fast in this area

• Communicates clearly with both external partners and non-technical restaurant staff

• Is curious about AI and how it can solve real business problems

• Is based in or around Copenhagen and can visit our restaurants when needed

• Communicates well in English

Experience with restaurant or retail systems, POS platforms, or kiosk and self-ordering systems is an advantage.

What We Offer

A broad and varied role close to daily operations, with real ownership of our systems and data, and room to shape how we use automation and AI going forward.

You will join an informal and international workplace where people work closely together and help each other succeed.

APPLICATION AND QUESTIONS

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact HR Manager Marcus Bak at bak@gasolinegrill.com.

All applications must be submitted through Teamtailor. Please note that applications sent by email or through other channels will not be considered.

Gasoline Grill encourages everyone to apply regardless of gender, sexuality, ethnicity, religion, age, disability, or background.

Do you want to lead project excellence across some of the largest and most complex infrastructure projects in Denmark? Are you an experienced project leader with a commercial mindset? Can you inspire and develop experienced project managers while improving project and portfolio performance? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

To further strengthen our project leadership and support the development of Transportation in Denmark, we are looking for a Vice President, Head of Projects. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of approximately 15 experienced multidisciplinary project managers, while taking direct responsibility for selected strategic projects. You will also have portfolio responsibility for medium-sized and smaller projects led by project managers across the organisation. You will report to the Senior Vice President, Transportation, in Denmark.

You will play a central role in connecting project delivery, portfolio performance, and strategic priorities. The portfolio comprises approximately 350 projects, from large multidisciplinary projects to smaller single-discipline assignments across key transportation disciplines. As a member of the Transportation leadership team, you will contribute to the strategic and operational development of the business.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• Lead and develop a team of multidisciplinary project managers, ensuring clear priorities and high-quality delivery across the portfolio.

• Act as project manager on selected strategic projects, with responsibility for scope, schedule, risk, commercial performance, and client satisfaction.

• Oversee and develop a portfolio of approximately 350 projects, ensuring governance, resource allocation, risk management, financial control, and profitable delivery.

• Improve commercial performance by identifying risks and opportunities early, leading contract and client negotiations, and balancing quality, customer value, and profitability.

• Advance project management excellence across Transportation by developing ways of working and promoting collaboration and knowledge sharing across projects and disciplines.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is your ability to combine strong project management expertise with commercial understanding, stakeholder engagement, and people leadership. You thrive in complex environments where collaboration, cross-team coordination, and professional credibility are essential. You are committed to developing project managers, strengthening project delivery, and creating long-term value for our customers.

On top of that, you will have:

• A degree in civil engineering or other relevant education.

• Extensive project management experience from large multidisciplinary infrastructure projects in Denmark.

• A commercial mindset and solid understanding of portfolio performance, contracts, negotiations, risk, client relations, and financial results.

• Experience developing project management competences and ways of working across teams or portfolios.

• Fluent written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Work location

The position is based in Lyngby or Aarhus, Denmark, with regular travel across our offices.

Want to know more?

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

Do you want to work on some of the largest Oil & Gas projects in the Danish sector of the North Sea? Have you been looking to join a company in growth with many opportunities for employment and great job security? Do you also want to have more time for your private life?
Then you are the one we have been looking for!

We are looking for welders for offshore work in the Danish sector. Throughout the year we will be adding 250 more workers to our manpower pool.

Your position
We offer you a unique opportunity to join Semco Maritime during our largest growth phase yet. You will be working in a turn based 2:2 or a 2:3 which means you will spend 2 weeks offshore and the 2 to 3 following weeks at home. That also means you will have a work/life balance most people will be envious of, because during the 2 weeks of the rotational period that you are home you can dedicate yourself fully to your family, your hobbies, and your passions.

Your tasks & responsibilities
Together with your team you will be playing a key part in ensuring the quality of our costumers’ offshore assets.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

• Carrying out daily tasks related to welding and pipefitting
• Assisting the mechanical team if needed
• Helping out the other teams when necessary
Qualifications
We imagine that you are good at teamwork and that you work with attention to detail. Furthermore, you should be comfortable with routine tasks and working with predefined processes and guidelines. It is important that you possess a safety-first mindset.

To be successful in this position we expect that you have the following qualifications:

• Educated/trained welder, smith, mechanic, pipefitter or similar
• Experience with welding processes 141, 111, 136
• Availability to pass site tests
• Preferably have offshore experience

Welcome to Semco Maritime
We offer you an interesting and challenging job in an international organization, where we strive to provide innovative and sustainable solutions globally.

There are opportunities for personal and professional development within the job. Furthermore, Semco Maritime is in growth so there are job opportunities for permanent employment.

There are both permanent positions and long duration project positions available.

We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, you must submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.
If you have any questions for the position, contact Stine Jessen at +45 79 16 66 66.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company dedicated to projects in the energy sector. For 40 years, we have been facilitating design, fabrication, service and maintenance of our customers’ assets, providing comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects. From turnkey engineering solutions to outsourcing of manpower and delivery of components, systems and solutions – we make sure our customers and partners in the energy sector experience safe and cost-efficient solutions. Semco Maritime has approx. 1,900 employees and branches in Denmark, Norway, United Kingdom, Germany, Singapore and the US. For further information, please see www.semcomaritime.com.

jobs.description:
Do you want to help build the technical protection layers that keep Denmark's electricity, gas and hydrogen infrastructure safe from cyber threats?

Energinet is looking for a skilled cyber security professional for our new Attack Surface Management department in the Group Cyber and Information Security unit. You will be the focal point for translating security requirements into concrete, operational solutions, from requirements documents to the finished implementation of security tools and technologies. 

Key responsibilities

• Oversee the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise information protection capabilities.
• Develop and implement data protection strategies covering data classification, labeling, encryption, data loss prevention (DLP), information governance, and secure data sharing.
• Oversee the deployment and enhancement of technologies such as Microsoft Purview and related information protection solutions.
• Ensure sensitive information is appropriately protected across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. 
• Develop security requirements, technical standards & baselines for infrastructure, platforms, applications, and data.
• Implement information security improvements across networks, endpoints, servers, cloud platforms, and supplier-integrated environments.
• Act as a technical authority on information protection and security engineering practices
• Translate technical findings into actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Define technical standards and security architectures for information protection and data governance.
• Guide project outcomes by ensuring security considerations are embedded early in technology initiatives.
• Collaborate with vendors and strategic partners to ensure solutions meet Energinet's security standards and operational requirements

“We offer a job with a high level of professionalism and great societal significance, where you help protect Denmark's critical energy infrastructure. You will have skilled colleagues, good opportunities for professional development and flexibility in everyday life – in an organization that is growing and where cyber security is a high priority” – Arpan Roy, Director, Attack Surface Management.

We expect you to

• Have a solid technical understanding of infrastructure - e.g. networks, servers, identity, cloud and on-prem environments.
• Have experience in implementing information protection technologies
• Can write precise requirements documents and technical documentation that others can act on.
• Have an education as an engineer, computer scientist or equivalent - or solid practical experience at the same level.
• Preferably have a relevant certification (e.g. Microsoft Security, GIAC or CISSP). 
• Works in a structured and self-managed manner and thrives on both immersion and collaboration.

About the department

At our office in Ballerup or Fredericia, you will be part of Attack Surface Management & Technical Cyber Protection – a new department under the Group Cyber and Information Security unit. The department is responsible for the technical protection layers that reduce Energinet's attack surface, vulnerability management, penetration testing, protection of platforms, data and applications, as well as secure configuration and hardening.

Together with the other departments in Cyber and Information Security, we are responsible for developing and operating the organisation, processes and technologies within cyber and information security in Energinet and for coordinating the IT preparedness in the electricity, gas and hydrogen sectors. You will have a broad interface across the IT and OT environment and get close to some of Denmark's most socially critical systems.

Want to know more?

If you have any questions about the job, you are very welcome to contact Arpan Roy at arroy@energinet.dk or on tel. +45 5161 2898. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send us your motivated cv as soon as possible.

Special conditions: As Energinet performs tasks critical to society, we carry out background checks prior to employment. Employment is conditional upon your background check being compatible with employment at Energinet. The background check is also carried out once a year.

The position also requires that you are able to obtain and maintain security clearance. On PET's website, you can read more about security clearance.

We see diversity as a strength and encourage all qualified people, regardless of background, to apply for the job. We work actively and determinedly with diversity in Energinet and therefore encourage you to exclude information about age, marital status, etc. to minimise outage biases in the process. You can read more about our diversity policy here.

Energinet is an independent public company that reprecents society's interests when supplying Denmark with electricity and gas and that the energy system is converted to green energy. Our culture is closely linked to our social responsibility, and we work actively with the UN's global goals on sustainable energy, climate action, partnerships for action as well as industry, innovation, and infrastructure. By leading the way in the green transition, we can help to solve the global climate challenge. New solutions require us to be able to see problems from many different angles, and diversity is therefore a keyword in our culture. We strive to listen to, involve and share our knowledge. Based on the values of courage and trust, we focus on constantly developing ourselves as an organisation and as people. Read more at our website www.energinet.dk.

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, influencing multidisciplinary teams, and continuously improving the way engineering is performed - this could be the right opportunity for you.
We are facing an exciting future with considerable growth and demanding changes. We continue to evolve our advanced technologies and mission critical solutions for the defense and aerospace industry to deliver real-world solutions that matter to the security of people on land, at sea and in the air. Therefore, we are looking for Systems Engineer to become part of this journey and contribute to our overall purpose – securing people through advanced technology.
 
Your role as part of the team
As a Systems Engineer within Maritime Projects, you will play a key role in defining technical solutions for some of our advanced defense systems. You will take ownership of technical decisions within assigned system areas while ensuring alignment with the overall system architecture. Throughout the product lifecycle, from early concept and proposal work to development, integration, verification, and customer delivery, you will drive systems engineering activities and help shape the best overall solutions.
In our team, we take pride in developing people and technology. You will become part of a team of 14 System Engineers focused on Maritime projects. As one of the first points of contact for new projects entering the Integrated Product Development department, the team supports project clarification and Sales activities. We work in an informal and collaborative environment where teamwork, knowledge sharing, and open dialogue are key. We care about the work we do and the people behind it.
Technical skills matter, but your mindset matters even more. If you combine strong technical capabilities with curiosity and a modern systems engineering mindset, you could be a great addition to our team. You thrive when collaborating across disciplines, can simplify complexity and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and know when to focus on details while maintaining a system-level perspective. Most importantly, you are motivated by finding the best solution for the complete system rather than a single discipline.
 
How you will make a meaningful contribution
In this role, you will contribute to a range of tasks across your area of responsibility. Your key responsibilities include:
·         Translating customer needs into clear, robust, and achievable technical solutions and identifying technical risks, assumptions, and dependencies early
·         Collaborating across engineering disciplines and stakeholders to ensure integrated system designs
·         Acting as technical owner for one or more system areas, ensuring technical consistency across software, hardware and operational requirements
·         Defining/supporting system architecture, requirements engineering, trade studies, and technical decision-making
·         Contributing to proposal work, engineering estimates, and technical planning
·         Helping improve engineering processes, methods, and collaboration across the organization.
 
Bring your expertise into play
To thrive in this role, we imagine that you bring some of the following qualifications:
·         You likely hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electronics, Computer Science, Physics, or another relevant technical discipline
·         You have a solid background in systems engineering and enjoy working with technically complex products
·         Experience within maritime, aerospace, defense, or other safety-critical industries is an advantage, but more important is your ability to understand complex systems and collaborate across disciplines
·         Experience with systems engineering methodologies, requirements engineering, system architecture, MBSE/INCOSE, interface technologies, distributed software systems, networking, sensor integration, and safety-critical systems is considered a significant advantage
·         Experience with technical leadership, proposal development, defense standards, Linux, and relevant industry standards such as MIL-STDs is an advantage.
Most importantly, we believe diverse experiences add value to our team and organization. Therefore, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the above requirements.
As we are an international organization, it is important that you are fluent in English both in writing and verbal at a professional level.
 
Let’s secure people through advanced technology
When joining Terma, we promise that you will experience great people, challenging tasks, and opportunities to make an impact on your daily work. Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, and open knowledge sharing, supporting your development along the way. Learning is part of everyday work, supported by colleagues at all stages of their careers – from students just starting out, to colleagues who have been part of Terma for decades.
 
Benefits
International Environment: Explore great teamwork and professional sparring with colleagues around the world.
Flexible Working Hours: The option to work from home up to two days per week.
Comprehensive Benefits Package: Receive a 10% paid pension along with a beneficial health care and insurance package and paid internet connection at home. Enjoy discounts from various business partners.
Well-being Perks: Opportunity to enroll in our on-site massage-offer at our locations in Denmark.
Social and Professional Events: We have an active staff association that arranges a variety of social activities and events to bring all of our colleagues together.
Career Paths: Opportunities to grow your career in a direction that suits you, whether you prefer a specialist path or a leadership role.
We are all Terma - diverse in skills and equal in value. That is why we encourage all individuals to apply and are committed to ensuring that every employee has equal opportunities to succeed and feel respected and valued within our organization. We strive to create an environment where all employees have equal opportunities to succeed, feel respected and valued, and experience a true sense of belonging.
To support an unbiased evaluation process, we kindly encourage applicants to omit personal details such as photos and age from their applications.
If you would like to take on the challenge of working in an innovative company, we look forward to receiving your application. A resume is required, while a cover letter is optional. To ensure that your application will reach us and is properly processed, we only accept applications via www.terma.com. Applications will be processed continuously.
 
Do you have any questions regarding the position?
Feel free to contact Hiring Manager on e-mail: FLCH@terma.com

jobs.occupation: Advanced Test Engineer, Test Manager, Research & Development
jobs.description:
Would you like to play a key role in leading and coordinating test activities where testing and quality are critical to advanced software solutions? Apply your expertise in a complex and specialized engineering environment. Come and join us!
 We are facing an exciting future with considerable growth and demanding changes, as we deliver advanced technologies and mission critical solutions for the defense and aerospace industry. Our systems provide security for people on land, at sea and in the air. Therefore, we are looking for Test Manager to become part of this journey and contribute to our overall purpose – securing people through advanced technology.
 
Your role in our team
 As our new Advanced Test Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our advanced software solutions within the R&D Defense Test Management department. You will be part of the Test Management team, working closely with experienced test engineers across R&D.
With a strong understanding of systems engineering, verification and validation processes, you will be responsible for securing product quality through strategic test planning, team leadership, test execution, test automation, and close collaboration with stakeholders.
 There is an increasing focus on CI/CD and multiple levels of test automation, which forms an important part of the role and is carried out in close cooperation with software developers, system engineers, fellow testers, and other technical specialists.
 The Test Management department is located across our offices in Lystrup and Søborg, and we expect you to work onsite as it is required for the role.
 
How you will make a meaningful contribution
 Your responsibilities will cover a wide range of testing activities to ensure the quality and reliability of our software solutions. Your key responsibilities include:
·         Plan, monitor, and control the integration and verification of the system
·         Responsible for the Verification Master Plan
·         Point of contact for the verification effort
·         Plan and drive in all test activities and ensure that the system meets the required standards and specifications

jobs.occupation: Compliance Officer for Financial and Non-Financial Risk Areas
jobs.description:
**About The Role

**Would you like to be part of an ambitious Compliance team where you play a key role in ensuring that Saxo meets its regulatory obligations within financial and non-financial risk areas?

If so, this may be the right opportunity for you at Saxo.

You will join the Prudential Oversight team within Group Compliance, Saxo's second line of defence function, based at our headquarters in Hellerup. Our team oversees compliance risks across a broad range of areas, including the financial risk areas of capital, market risk, liquidity and credit risk, as well as non-financial risk areas such as ICT, operational risk, model risk, data governance and strategy, supporting the business in meeting regulatory requirements, market standards and internal policies.

Your primary responsibility will be to conduct compliance oversight and monitoring across the financial risk areas of capital, market risk, liquidity and credit risk as well as non-financial areas such as operational risk, model risk and strategic risks in relation to policies, procedures, segregation of duties, limits, calculations, samples, controls, etc.

However, if you are curious about the other areas covered by the team, we will help you develop your skills and knowledge within these areas.

As a team, we balance professionalism with a sense of humour and maintain an informal atmosphere where people enjoy coming to work.

**Responsibilities

**

• Perform compliance risk assessments

• Provide advice and compliance opinions to the business on managing compliance risks and regulatory requirements

• Conduct compliance monitoring activities

• Contribute to regular compliance reporting to senior management of the bank

• Participate in developing the bank’s compliance framework

• Interact with the business across organisational levels and seniority

**Your profile

**We are looking for a colleague with experience from working with one or more prudential risk areas, who is motivated to develop deeper expertise in these areas.

**Further We Expect You To Have

**

• At least 2 years of relevant experience from the financial sector, preferably within compliance, risk management, audit, finance, credit or another relevant first-line function

• A relevant educational background within economics, finance, accounting, audit or similar

• Interest in prudential risk areas such as capital, liquidity, market risk, credit risk, model risk, strategic risk, operational risk areas, governance, and internal controls

• Familiarity with regulatory requirements such as CRR/CRD, Basel guidelines, EBA/ESMA guidelines, the Executive Order on Management and Control of Banks and other relevant Danish financial regulation is an advantage

Moreover, we are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, can work independently while taking an active role in teamwork and enjoys collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders across the entire organisation.

It is an advantage if you thrive in an environment with constant change, bring a positive and curious mindset to work, and do not buy into the word ‘cannot’.

You must possess strong stakeholder management skills and use your communication skills to ensure positive collaboration and progress in joint tasks. We are looking for a colleague who always brings a positive attitude when liaising with the business.

Please note! International applicants are encouraged to apply. To help us understand your circumstances, we kindly ask candidates currently based outside Denmark to include a brief summary of their relocation plans and expected timeframe for relocating to Denmark.

**We get curious people invested in the world

**When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

**How To Apply

**Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

The Impact You'll Make

At Danfoss Power Solutions, we're strengthening the cost competitiveness of our Connect & Control Solutions (CCS) portfolio to support future growth and profitability. As our new Sourcing Project Manager, Pipeline, based in Nordborg, Denmark, you'll play a key role in that journey.

Working across sourcing, engineering, operations, and finance, you'll identify and drive cost optimization initiatives that improve product competitiveness and create lasting value for our customers. You'll help advance our design-to-cost approach and deliver sustainable cost improvements across a global product portfolio.

This is an opportunity to influence strategic decisions, collaborate with stakeholders across a global matrix organization, and turn ideas into measurable business results.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Lead pipeline generation of cross-functional cost optimization projects that improve product competitiveness and deliver measurable business value

• Identify and prioritize cost reduction opportunities through data-driven analysis and collaboration to build a strong pipeline of impactful initiatives.

• Facilitate workshops and improvement activities that generate ideas, align stakeholders, and accelerate implementation

• Influence and align stakeholders across sourcing, engineering, operations, and finance to secure commitment and successfully deliver results

What We're Looking For

• Strong project management experience with a track record of leading cross-functional initiatives and delivering measurable business results

• An engineering background, preferably within electronics, or a strong technical understanding of products, manufacturing processes, and cost drivers

• Experience with cost reduction, sourcing/procurement, engineering, or a combination of these areas, including identifying and implementing improvement opportunities

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, build strong partnerships, and navigate a complex global matrix organization

• A growth mindset and passion for continuous improvement, combined with strong analytical and problem-solving skills, creativity, and the ability to balance detailed analysis with broader business goals

What You'll Get from Us

This is a high-impact role within Danfoss Power Solutions, where you'll help shape the future cost competitiveness of our CCS portfolio.

Furthermore:

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

Travel: Approximately 30 days per year

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you're excited about driving cost optimization, collaborating across functions, and turning opportunities into measurable business results, we'd love to hear from you. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Your experience, perspective, and problem-solving mindset could be exactly what we're looking for.

Our Commitment to Transparency

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Brand

Danfoss engineers solutions that increase machine productivity, reduce emissions, lower energy consumption, and enable electrification.

Our solutions are used in areas such as refrigeration, air conditioning, heating, power conversion, motor control, industrial machinery, marine, and on- and off-highway equipment. We also provide solutions for data centers, renewable energy, energy storage, heat recovery, as well as contribute to district energy solutions for cities.

Mapon has already built the scale, trust and reach of an established European B2B SaaS and telematics company, and we are still far from finished. Those 200+ colleagues work across eight Mapon branches: Latvia, Spain, Estonia, Finland, Denmark, Lithuania, Sweden and Ireland, with our headquarters in Riga, Latvia. **✅ Why Join Mapon?

That gives Mapon a strong foundation for the next stage of growth: deeper relationships in the markets where we are already present, more businesses to reach and new opportunities to unlock. For Sales, it means a credible story to take to customers, backed by a platform that delivers real value and plenty of potential ahead.

You’ll have your closest teammates nearby, while also working with colleagues across our eight branches and beyond, sharing market insights and helping grow one product across different countries. It’s the best of both worlds: a strong local team and a genuinely international way of working.

**💻 Role Description

**As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you’ll be the first point of contact for many of our future customers. You’ll reach out to companies across different industries to introduce Mapon’s fleet management and asset-tracking solutions. Your mission: generate high-quality leads, book meetings with potential clients, and support the Growth and Sales teams in growing our presence in the Danish market.

A typical week will include researching and identifying potential customers, reaching out through calls, emails and LinkedIn, following up on conversations and building new sales opportunities, giving you plenty of room to sharpen your B2B sales skills and take ownership of your results.

**🚀How Your Onboarding Will Look Like

You’ll connect with businesses facing real, everyday fleet challenges and introduce solutions that can make a meaningful difference to their operations. It’s a chance to strengthen your B2B sales skills, take ownership of your results, and grow your career with an established international SaaS company.

**

• Reach out to potential clients via cold calls, emails, and LinkedIn

• Qualify leads through discovery conversations

• Schedule and book meetings with potential clients for our Sales Manager

• Share feedback from prospects to help improve sales approaches and product positioning

**

**🌍 Join an international team of 200+ colleagues with global reach and local soul.

Senior Specialist, People Operations Transformation is a strategic transformation role responsible for strengthening People Operations and Payroll through improved data governance, process effectiveness, operational controls, reporting, systems enablement and automation. The role is not accountable for day-to-day operational execution; instead, it focuses on designing, improving and implementing sustainable, scalable and efficient ways of working across People Operations and Payroll.

The role owns the continuous improvement of People Experience across key operational touchpoints, including preboarding, offboarding, leave management, query management, employee lifecycle administration and employee and manager satisfaction measurement. While the role remains closely connected to operational realities, this is through data, insights, stakeholder feedback and process review rather than direct operational delivery.

As the primary subject matter expert for People Operations and Payroll data quality, operational controls, systems enablement and transformation initiatives, the Specialist is accountable for strengthening data integrity, applying a Six Sigma approach to measuring process effectiveness, establishing sustainable controls, improving operational reporting and driving automation. This includes supporting the implementation of ServiceNow HRSD, introducing automated workflows and working closely with GBS to identify opportunities for robots and automation that reduce manual effort and improve service consistency.

The role works closely with GO People Operations, Payroll, GBS, People Experience, Employee Relations, and other relevant stakeholders to translate operational requirements into scalable processes, technology enhancements, automated workflows and more efficient ways of working. The role also brings external insight into People Operations and Payroll by identifying best practice, latest research and inspiration from other organisations to continuously improve the employee and manager experience.

Strategic Accountabilities

• Service design and operating model: Define and improve scalable People Operations and Payroll processes, service standards, ownership models, hand-offs and escalation routes in line with the One Team model and the future tiered Service Delivery Model.

• Data governance and controls: Establish governance standards, control requirements, reconciliation principles and audit-ready evidence standards across People Operations and Payroll.

• Systems and HRSD enablement: Own strategic requirements for SuccessFactors and ServiceNow HRSD, translating business needs into process design, workflow requirements, system enhancements, testing, training and adoption plans.

• Automation and robotics: Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, variation and repetitive work through automated workflows, robotics and close collaboration with GBS.

• Insights and continuous improvement: Use KPIs, process measures, satisfaction data, stakeholder feedback, external best practice and latest research to identify priorities and drive sustained improvement.

• Change and implementation: Lead structured implementation of transformation initiatives, including stakeholder engagement, communications, change planning, adoption and handover into business ownership.

Key Success Measures

• Improved data accuracy, control effectiveness and audit readiness across People Operations and Payroll.

• Reduced manual effort, errors, rework and process variation through automation, robotics and improved workflows.

• Successful implementation and adoption of ServiceNow HRSD and the tiered Service Delivery Model.

• Clearer service ownership, escalation routes, standards and hand-offs across People Operations, Payroll and relevant People Experience touchpoints.

• Improved employee and manager satisfaction through simpler, more consistent and insight-led service delivery.

• Use of a Six Sigma-inspired measurement approach to define baselines, track errors and rework, identify root causes and evidence sustained process improvement.

• Delivery of agreed transformation milestones with sustainable handover into business ownership.

Fit within the One Team People Operations Model

• Employees and managers are supported collectively by the operational People Operations and Payroll teams, rather than through dedicated Business Unit alignment.

• The wider People Operations role design preserves the One Team model while creating clearer specialist ownership and protected capacity for agreed focus areas.

• Operational specialists and associate specialists deliver day-to-day employee and manager services; this role complements them by creating the conditions for those services to become more scalable, automated, data-led and consistent.

• This role strengthens the foundations that enable consistent service delivery, including standards, governance, controls, reporting, automation, systems, HRSD enablement and service design.

• Day-to-day operational execution remains with the relevant operational teams; this role focuses on strategic improvement, implementation and enablement.

• Transformation priorities are informed by operational insight from operational teams, Payroll, Employee Relations, People Experience, GBS and People Experience & Services, but remain focused on scalable, future-ready solutions rather than live case delivery.

Fit within the Wider People Experience Team

The Senior Specialist, People Operations Transformation also plays an important enabling role across the wider People Experience team. While the role is anchored in People Operations and Payroll transformation, its impact extends across People Experience, Employee Relations and Talent Acquisition because these areas are connected through shared employee and manager journeys, service touchpoints, data, systems and process hand-offs.

Within the wider People Experience team, this role helps turn strategic priorities into practical, scalable service improvements. It supports a more joined-up employee and manager experience by identifying where processes, technology, automation, knowledge, controls and service standards need to be better connected across the full employee lifecycle — from attraction and hiring through preboarding, employment, employee relations matters, leave management, query resolution and offboarding.

• People Operations and Payroll: strengthens the core service delivery model through data governance, automation, HRSD implementation, controls, reporting and process effectiveness.

• People Experience: ensures operational touchpoints are designed around a simple, consistent and positive employee and manager experience, using satisfaction data, best practice and external insights to inform improvements.

• Employee Relations: works closely with the Manager, Employee Relations to ensure processes, hand-offs, documentation, escalation routes and service standards support compliant, consistent and sensitive handling of employee matters.

• Talent Acquisition: connects hiring, preboarding and onboarding touchpoints so candidates, new joiners, hiring managers and People teams experience a clear, consistent and well-managed transition into employment.

In this way, the role acts as a strategic connector across the wider People Experience team. It does not own the functional agendas of People Experience, Employee Relations or Talent Acquisition, but it helps ensure that the processes, systems, data, automation and service design behind those agendas are joined up, measurable and scalable. This makes the role critical to building a more consistent, insight-led and future-ready employee and manager experience across the organisation.
